column1: event|01-27|1958|Ταραχές στη Λευκωσία με επτά νεκρούς Τουρκοκύπριους|Riots in Nicosia leave seven Turkish Cypriots dead|On 27 January 1958 riots broke out in Nicosia, where Turkish Cypriot crowds protested against a British plan that did not provide for partition. Seven Turkish Cypriots were killed in clashes with British troops, and the violence continued the following day.

event|07-16|1974|Ο Μακάριος φεύγει από την Κύπρο με βρετανικό ελικόπτερο|Makarios leaves Cyprus by British helicopter|After the 15 July 1974 coup, Archbishop Makarios III was taken from Paphos by British helicopter to the British bases. He reached London the same night.

event|07-17|1974|Ο Μακάριος συναντά τον Γουίλσον στο Λονδίνο|Makarios meets Harold Wilson in London|Makarios met British Prime Minister Harold Wilson in London the day after leaving Cyprus. The meeting dealt with the crisis that the coup had caused on the island.

event|07-19|1974|Ο Μακάριος στο Συμβούλιο Ασφαλείας του ΟΗΕ|Makarios addresses the UN Security Council|Makarios told the UN Security Council that the coup was an invasion by the Greek junta. His speech came one day before the Turkish invasion of Cyprus.

event|07-20|1974|Τουρκική εισβολή στην Κύπρο|Turkey invades Cyprus|Turkey launched a military invasion of Cyprus, the first phase of which was called Attila I. The invasion followed the 15 July coup that had overthrown Makarios.

event|07-25|1974|Αρχίζει ο πρώτος γύρος της Διάσκεψης της Γενεύης|First Geneva peace round opens|The first round of peace talks on Cyprus began in Geneva and lasted until 30 July. The talks took place after the Turkish invasion and the ceasefire.

event|09-01|1958|Μάχη της Λιοπέτρι|Battle of Liopetri begins|On 1 September 1958 an EOKA team of four attacked British soldiers at Liopetri. All four EOKA fighters were killed in the gun battle that followed.

event|11-19|1958|Θάνατος του Κυριάκου Ματσή στην Κερύνεια|Kyriakos Matsis killed near Kyrenia|Kyriakos Matsis, EOKA leader for the Kyrenia area, was killed on 19 November 1958. He died from a grenade during a gun battle with security forces at Dikomo, near Kyrenia.
